key_points: Q3 2026 earnings beat with higher adjusted earnings (CAD 167 increase) and reaffirmed full-year guidance
Management reaffirmed 21st consecutive year of meeting guidance with $38 billion secured backlog
Dividend yield of 5.7% makes ENB an attractive income play compared to peers like Kinder Morgan (3%)
Growth narrative strengthened in Western Canada pipeline sector with CEO adjusting oil forecast upward
Stock was already down 4.3% over 7 days, but fundamental earnings and dividend strength support a bullish outlook
